title: Titanium Spent Fuel Cask Bolt
function: Spent fuel transport cask high-strength bolt
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this nuclear hardware application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by spent fuel transport cask high-strength bolt and specific design requirements.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for nuclear hardware geometry
CNC precision machining with Class 6g gauge
TIG welding all positions with Class 6g gauge
DPI dye penetrant inspect with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for spent fuel transport application
inspection: PMI XRF alloy verify (spent fuel verified)
commonFailures: Thermal ratcheting under cyclic temperature - controlled by stress-relief anneal 675C 2h Ar below beta-transus — critical for spent fuel transport performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Spent Fuel Cask Bolt suitable for Spent fuel transport cask high-strength bolt?
faq.a: Titanium Spent Fuel Cask Bolt uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address nuclear hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Spent Fuel Cask Bolt?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Spent Fuel Cask Bolt is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for spent fuel transport requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Spent Fuel Cask Bolt require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. spent fuel transport components require Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for spent fuel transport application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Spent Fuel Cask Bolt shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Spent Fuel Cask Bolt includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet spent fuel transport specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
